policy.F8: Fixed nonpointer fixture staging/release only. Exact original held-work log and fresh root/client review; full-frame pixel differences recorded, not masked. Pointer/hover/Tab retain equality.
policy.initial_resize: One fixed initial nonpointer layout. Exact original scene phase/work and owned source/UI/window/geometry; fresh full root/client hashes and differences retained. Conserved resize_focus acquires and verifies native focus. No pointer equality exemption.
policy.scroll: No wheel/new primitive. Narrow scrollbar work is review-only backlog unless a genuine rail is visible; never guess a target.
policy.terminal: Source oracle, missing control and screenshots are separate observations; no automatic UX PASS.
